VisitPage.title: Plan Your Visit
VisitPage.subtitle: Practical guidance for a meaningful pilgrimage to the Holy Land. Specific details are confirmed on each site’s page.
VisitPage.hoursBody: Hours and service times vary by site and season. Check each church’s page or contact it directly before you travel.
VisitPage.accessBody: Many historic sites have steps and uneven ground. Where accessibility information is confirmed, it appears on the site’s page.
VisitPage.toursBody: Guided visits and pilgrim groups are available at many sites. Arrange these in advance where possible.
VisitPage.stayBody: Accommodation, transport and refreshments are available in the surrounding towns and cities.
